## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short Esoteric ritual manual by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) presenting the *one-mudrā* (一印, i.e. abbreviated single-mudrā) form of the Avalokiteśvara heart-mantra recitation. The *yīyìn* ("one-mudrā") format is a deliberately abbreviated practice-form designed for daily liturgical use or for practitioners not yet ready for the full Esoteric *aṣṭa-mudrā* maṇḍala procedures.

**Abstract**

The *yīyìn niànsòng fǎ* (one-mudrā recitation method) is one of Amoghavajra's recurring formats — a stripped-down ritual procedure using a single principal *mudrā* and the heart-mantra alone, suitable for routine daily liturgy or for practitioners who have not yet undergone full *abhiṣeka* (consecration) into the *Vajraśekhara* maṇḍala. The text accompanies the more extensive Avalokiteśvara ritual manuals ([KR6j0228](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0228)–[KR6j0231](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0231), [KR6j0238](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0238)) as the abbreviated practice-form of the same liturgical tradition. This format-pairing is characteristic of Amoghavajra's compositional method.
